title: Foreign Influence Transparency Registry — public operational status

facts.claim: FITAA (Foreign Influence Transparency and Accountability Act) enacted as part of Bill C-70 / S.C. 2024 c.16 — registration regime not fully operational until office/regulations live.
Office of the Foreign Influence Commissioner of Canada states office opens August 4, 2026; registration not yet available as of page check 2026-07.
facts.verbatim_notice: The Office will open on August 4, 2026. You can't register yet.

facts.claim: Draft regulations gazetted for consultation (Canada Gazette Jan 2026); consultation closed early Feb 2026 per secondary legal briefings.
Public Safety nominated proposed Commissioner (Anton Boegman named in public commentary / ministerial announcement class March 2026).

osint_assessment.5gw_implication: Transparency tool promised after Hogue/NSICOP still yields zero public foreign-influence entries while information-domain conflict (CBC/CPC mesh) is fully live — structural lag in FI countermeasures.
